subject: Biology
sourceText: Water moves down its chemical potential gradient across a semipermeable membrane via passive osmosis until the hydrostatic pressure counters the osmotic potential.
learningObjective: Understand passive transport and osmotic equilibrium in cellular membranes.
expectedConcept: Difference in water concentration driving natural flow, analogous to water flowing downhill.
notes: Validates bridging from mechanical slope analogies to formal thermodynamic potential gradients.
